title: Broncos Release Unofficial Week 1 Depth Chart ahead of Chiefs showdown

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos Release Unofficial Week 1 Depth Chart ahead of Chiefs showdown
sources.description: The Denver Broncos have released their unofficial Week 1 depth chart ahead of their Monday Night showdown vs. their division rivals, the Kansas City Chiefs. It is an “unofficial depth chart”; Head Coach Sean Payton isn’t giving away everything, but we still can learn a few things about the Broncos roster from this depth chart […]
